Messages.Author: martijn
Messages.Body:
case:
Sargon: "Whenever Sargon successfully performs an action, you get the Edge"
Regaining the upper hand: "Choose a Methuselah. Successful <referendum>
means the chosen Methuselah gets the Edge".
question: who gets the edge if Sargon succesfully calls this referendum
(referendum passes), choosing a different methuselah than the methuselah
controlling Sargon (his prey, for example)?

possibilities include:
a: the methuselah controlling sargon immediately gets the edge
b: the choosen methuselah immediately gets the edge
c: the methuselah controlling sargon gets the edge for an instant, then the
edges passes to the chosen methuselah
d: the chosen methuselah gets the edge for an instant, then the edges
passes to the methuselah controlling sargon
e: neither methuselah gets the edge; edge is now uncontrolled
f: neither methuselah gets the edge; edge remains uncontrolled or with
methuselah who had it before the referendum was called
g: sargon cannot call this referendum if another methuselah is choosen
h: ???

if answer is c or d: does the instant of possessing the edge give that
methuselah the opportunity to burn the edge to get rid of
extorion/threat-counters; is that methuselah is your prey, do you gain a
form counter on your form of corruption (each time your prey gets the Edge
anew, put a form counter on this card).

gr. MW
